metadata.description: A marketplace of Claude Code skills for Tobrun's development workflows

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Development workflow skills: discover unknowns before planning, plan and split work into layer-tagged tasks, implement test-first across unit/integration/e2e with a running notes log, review it with a verified fan-out panel, and turn finished work into a pitch or a comprehension quiz - no standing knowledge base, and every phase publishes its own HTML view as a shareable Artifact.
